caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a sculpted pipe bowl in the form of a man's head and neck, shown in three perspectives on a plain background. The central and largest view is a colored rendering, showing the object in profile facing left. The man's head is brown in color, resembling carved wood, with finely detailed hair, beard, ear, and facial features. He wears a cylindrical, metallic-looking cap colored in shades of gray and silver, with a band at the base. There is a hollow opening at the back of the neck, set at an angle. Two additional line drawings without color are positioned near the upper right and lower left corners of the main rectangle. The top-right sketch is a frontal view of the man's face, showing the same cap, facial details, and a bowtie at the collar. The lower-left sketch is a rear view, depicting the back of the cap, hair, and the round opening. The whole arrangement is on a white or light beige background, with a clear border around the drawing, and the artist's name "Carl Keksi" is printed at the bottom center of the page.
title: Pipe Head: Lincoln
